notes.title: 🎊Demo Update🎊 - 🐻Bear Character, procedural levels and more
notes.content:
Loads of bug fixes and new content in this update :

- Bear is now available
- Procedural generated levels
- Better controller support
- Better screen shake
- Loads of changes to enemy behaviour
- New sounds and music
- More robust back end systems
- Boss fight now spawns more enemies
- Loads of readability issues
- fixes to store not saving 
- store can now be reset for a small amount.
- resolution settings added

notes.title: 🎉 Demo Released!
notes.content:
The demo for Hemlock is now live on Steam! Take a peek into the world of Hemlock and get a taste of its action-packed roguelite adventure.

Explore handcrafted levels, battle formidable foes, and uncover the secrets of Hemlock as you work to save the city from impending doom.

Download the demo now and embark on this thrilling journey. Your feedback is crucial as I continue to develop the game.

Thanks for joining the adventure!
